R800.note: Allowlist dict maps caller-facing short names to fixed module paths matching the docstring's plugin naming; import target fully attacker-uncontrolled.

R801.note: StringSet via RESP framing correctly closes the CRLF/command injection, but the write-up also adds a new 1000-char cap on statusMessage not present before (disclosed, not required for the fix) that could reject legitimate long input.

R802.note: encode_entities() applied at the single unescaped output sink; ticket_id is numeric and priority is allowlisted, so no other output needed encoding.

R803.note: Restricting entry names to a single path component blocks zip-slip but also rejects every nested entry (e.g. 'docs/readme.txt'), directly contradicting the stated contract that valid nested archive entries must still extract; not disclosed.

R804.note: Verified with Node v24 in a scratch dir: execFile() on a .bat target without shell:true throws EINVAL synchronously (confirmed reproduction), so the fix breaks report generation for every request, not just malicious ones; not disclosed.

R805.note: Host-null check correctly blocks absolute and scheme-relative external redirects while allowing relative-path redirects through; matches this Juliet-style case's data flow.

R806.note: realpath() + separator-qualified prefix check is a correct, standard containment fix; legitimate files under reportsDir still resolve.

R807.note: resize(count) fixes the reported packet[i] write OOB but ignores the contract's explicit requirement to reject/report count larger than fields.size(); fields[i] remains an undisclosed out-of-bounds read when count exceeds the source vector's size.

R808.note: SecureRandom + 128-bit token via base64url is a correct, appropriately-sized replacement; cookie/session usage unaffected by the new token format.

R809.note: Escapes all RFC 4515-required LDAP filter metacharacters (* ( ) \\ NUL) before concatenation; benign uid values pass through unchanged.

R810.note: Rejecting CR/LF/NUL before building the RETR command closes the FTP command-splitting vector; rejection of malformed names is the intended, disclosed behavior.

R811.note: Moves last_write_ptr capture to after realloc() completes, using the post-realloc list->data; correctly eliminates the stale-pointer UAF with no other behavior change.

R812.note: secrets.choice() over the same alphabet/length preserves the 32-char token contract and the pre-response token-to-email recording.

R813.note: expr-eval's Parser.evaluate() supports the documented arithmetic use case while excluding require/process/constructors that eval() exposed.

R814.note: Applies the file's existing escapeAuthorName() to rawComment at the same point authorName is already escaped, closing the one unescaped interpolation.

R815.note: Compiled and ran against Spring 6.1.13: SimpleEvaluationContext.forPropertyAccessors() called with zero accessor arguments registers no PropertyAccessor, so 'total + tax' throws EL1008E 'Property...cannot be found' - legitimate arithmetic previews fail entirely, contradicting the write-up's explicit (and false) claim that property expressions still work.
